|lore=Gigantic silicon-based lifeform. Exists in the vacuum of space. Devours small vessels whole. Has difficulty keeping its modified light freighters down.
|game_text=<nowiki>*</nowiki> Ferocity = two destiny. Habitat: Big One (Asteroid Cave is now Belly). Will attack starfighters (defeated cards are eaten or relocated to Belly, your choice). Once per turn, may open or close mouth.
|joke="Has difficulty keeping its modified light freighters down" treats the ''Millennium Falcon'' (a "Modified Light Freighter" on its [[Millennium Falcon]] card) as food the slug could not keep down, after the Falcon escapes from its mouth in ''The Empire Strikes Back''. [[This Is No Cave]] and [[Shot In The Dark]] joke about the same slug. See [[Jokes#Space Slug (Dark)|Jokes]].
